newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shrs jump on gains in Dow, Telefonica.
newsitem.headline: Lima shrs jump on gains in Dow, Telefonica.

text.p: Shares on a bullish Lima Stock Exchange rallied to close three percent higher Monday on the back of a firmer Wall Street and a surge of interest in benchmark Telefonica del Peru.
The gains were expected to continue Tuesday, although brokers predicted some profit-taking in the mining sector, which has seen consistently strong gains in recent weeks.

The blue-chip index closed up 2.96 percent at 2,597.46 points, while the general index closed 2.53 percent higher at 1,790.84, according to preliminary figures on the market which closed at 1.30 p.m. local time (1830 GMT).
